data.title: IRPC receives Gold Human Rights Award for third consecutive year

data.title: Decoding ‘medical innovation’: driving Thailand’s economy and transforming healthcare
data.description: Amid the dual pressures of a rapidly ageing society and a sharp rise in non-communicable diseases (NCDs), Thailand faces a critical challenge: optimising public healthcare budgets to ensure all citizens have equal, life-saving access to modern medical care. A high-level multi-stakeholder policy dialogue titled “Advancing Thailand’s Medical Economy through Health Innovation,” was convened in Bangkok by the US-Asean Business Council in early September this year, marked a significant milestone in shaping the country’s healthcare economy through international collaboration. Attended by officials from the US Embassy, health economics experts, healthcare professionals and global life sciences leaders, the forum outlined a vision to transform the nation’s healthcare landscape in the long term.

data.title: True Digital Park’s “Hello, Connecting to New Possibilities” Wins Influencer Award
data.description: Reinforcing its role as a tech and startup ecosystem that connects people, businesses, and opportunities from around the world, True Digital Park, Southeast Asia’s largest tech and startup hub, has won the Best Property & Real Estate Influencer Campaign at the Thailand Influencer Awards 2026, recognising the success of its “Hello, Connecting to New Possibilities” campaign. Built around the simple yet powerful idea of “Hello” as the starting point for new connections, the campaign highlights how meaningful connections can open doors to new opportunities, support business growth, expand partnerships, and strengthen the technology community. It also reflects True Digital Park’s role as a hub that brings together people, businesses, technology, and new possibilities under the concept of “One Roof, All Possibilities”.

data.title: TCG Launches "Nano Plus" to Support Over 100,000 Micro SMEs
data.description: Dr. Ekniti Nitithanprapas, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, presided over the launch of the Nano Plus Loan Guarantee Programme and delivered a keynote address titled “Financial Opportunities for Small Businesses.” Also attending were Mr. Lawaron Saengsanit, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Finance; Ms. Jindarat Viriyataweekul, Chairwoman of the Board of Directors of the Thai Credit Guarantee Corporation (TCG); representatives of state financial institutions; executives from Non-Bank institutions providing nano-finance services; and public and private sector partners. The event was held at the Kumpanthong Room, 21st Floor, 150th Anniversary Building, Ministry of Finance, on 22 September 2026.

data.title: S-Pure Eggs Earns First 'Thai Golden Eggs' Certification for Zero Salmonella
data.description: Bangkok – 24 September 2026 – S-Pure, a super-premium food brand produced by Betagro Public Company Limited (BTG), has earned the ‘Thai Golden Eggs’ certification by the Department of Livestock Development, making it Thailand’s first and only brand recognised for exceptional freshness, strict Salmonella-free standards, and superior breeder selection. data.title: TOA Launches ‘TOA Wood Expert’ Campaign to Promote Sustainable Wood Care
data.description: As a comprehensive wood-care expert and a leader in eco-friendly paint innovations and construction materials in Thailand, TOA Paint (Thailand) is building on this philosophy with its major annual campaign, “TOA Wood Expert: Caring for Wood Together.” Under the concept “Caring for the Wood at Home Means Caring for the Wood in the Forest,” the campaign encourages Thais to look beyond simply extending the lifespan of wooden products and to embrace more responsible resource consumption and greater environmental awareness.

data.title: Huawei, SVOA and ACONNECT Join Forces to Advance AI-Powered Customer Service
data.description: Bangkok, 21 September 2026 – Huawei, SVOA Public Company Limited (SVOA), and “Aconnect Contact Center”, a business of Advanced Research Group (ARG) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Artificial Intelligence Contact Center (AICC) solutions, marking a new step in their collaboration to develop AI-powered customer service solutions for organisations in Thailand. The collaboration aims to enhance Contact Center efficiency and elevate customer experience, with an initial focus on banking, insurance, retail, and large enterprises.

data.title: Bangkok Launches New Effort to Address Health Impacts of Extreme Heat
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) today announced the city will begin development of its Integrated and Evidence-Based Heat–Health Action Plan as part of Bangkok’s work with the Partnership for Healthy Cities—a global network of more than 70 cities committed to saving lives by preventing noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) and injuries. The initiative, launched in collaboration with the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), will use scientific evidence to identify the neighborhoods where heat poses the greatest health risks, who is most vulnerable, and what measures can better protect residents.

data.title: Vacheron Constantin and The Met to unveil three artisan artworks in New York
data.description: Vacheron Constantin (@vacheronconstantin) and The MET in New York, is set to unveil three artworks from the Artisan Residency Program on October 8, 2026. A mentorship programme and creativity through an exchange of knowledge and expertise between artisans at Vacheron Constantin’s watchmaking manufacture in Switzerland and The MET in New York over an 18-month period. The three artworks were created by the selected artisans participating in the program.
